verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published memory type (e.g., DDR5 speed), no memory capacity ceiling, and no bandwidth figures or clock/channel specs from which bandwidth could be derived — only marketing mentions of EXPO overclocking, ECC 'requires mobo support', and on-die 3D V-Cache (which is not system RAM). Missing for 10: memory type/speed spec, max supported memory capacity, number of channels, and bandwidth or derivable throughput numbers.
